title: AdCode Policy Rule
description: A declarative policy rule evaluated at validate_stack and plan_stack time.

id.description: Unique rule identifier. Stack-local rules with the same id override builtin rules.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule checks.

severity.description: ERROR blocks apply_stack. WARNING is advisory only.

scope.description: Which template object type this condition applies to.

field.description: For field_required: dot-path to the field that must be present.

fields.description: For any_field_nonempty: at least one of these dot-paths must be a non-empty list.

row_field.description: For compatibility_matrix: first field in the tuple. Use 'campaign.' prefix to read from parent campaign.

col_field.description: For compatibility_matrix: second field in the tuple.

third_field.description: For compatibility_matrix: third field in the tuple.

allowed.description: For compatibility_matrix: list of allowed [row, col, third] value triples.

message.description: Violation message. '{name}' is replaced with the object name.
